_comment: The Research Lab's 12 items, docs/04-upgrades.md §4.6 Branches B and C,
authored verbatim from the doc's own table. Branch A ('Tier Gates') is
the Spire's own per-node L20/L40/L60 gates, already SpireWorkshop
'implemented: false' items are real, purchasable content with no live
effect yet - each has its own specific, checked reason in

items.name: Second Loadout
items.description: Save/swap a full hero + arrow + Mark set.

items.name: Boon Banking
items.description: Carry 1 Boon from a failed run into the next.
items.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0093. Which Boon gets banked on a failed run is not specified (a player choice needs a UI this Part doesn't build; an automatic policy would be invented, not derived).

items.name: Shrine Ledger
items.description: See the next Boon set before buying a reroll.
items.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0093. Needs a reroll 'peek' that previews the next draw without consuming the RNG or the reroll charge unless confirmed - a new BoonPool/StageRunner API, not a flag.

items.name: Double Draw
items.description: Tier III can overcharge into a one-off Tier IV shot.
items.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0093. A whole new Draw tier - comparable in scope to a hero's own kit, not a flag on an existing one.

items.name: Elemental Codex
items.description: See exact reaction previews on the HUD.
items.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0093. Purely presentational - a HUD feature with no sim-side effect to wire at all.

items.name: Deep Descent
items.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0093. Endless Descent itself exists in the sim, but no 'difficulty tier 1-5' selection concept exists anywhere to gate.

items.name: Auto-claim chests
items.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0093. No chest-claim UI exists yet to automate.

items.name: Skip run intro
items.description: Skips the run's own intro sequence.
items.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0093. Presentational - no run-intro sequence exists yet to skip.

items.name: Damage-number toggle
items.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0093. Presentational - a HUD/settings toggle, no sim-side effect.

items.name: Extra Vigor notification
items.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0093. No notification system exists yet.

items.name: Combat log
items.description: A readable log of a run's own combat events.
items.balanceNote: Deferred - see ADR 0093. Presentational - no combat-log UI exists yet.
